h1: Custom Green Lanyards for Events & Branding
metaDescription: Order custom green lanyards for events, schools, or corporate branding. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Green lanyards are a popular choice for outdoor events, environmental initiatives, and springtime promotions. Whether you need 3/8" knit-in lanyards for a trade show or 1" woven lanyards with full-color printing, green offers high visibility and a fresh, natural look. Pair them with a bulldog clip or lobster clasp for secure badge holding. Custom imprinting options include silkscreen, woven, or dye-sublimated logos to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom green lanyards with printed logos and metal clips for ID badges
